title: Trotula dose-total versus equal-parts mixture relations
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. The cached complete Trotula IV–VI source contains a five-ingredient one-drachm recipe with a two-drachm total dose, a distinct one-drachm/one-scruple alternative, a four-ingredient two-ounce base, and an equal-parts mixture reduced by boiling. A finite typed arithmetic account distinguishes total-dose, per-ingredient-dose, equal-initial-parts, and consumed-volume operations without assigning any target numeral word.

design.access: Existing cached source dossier and already report-owned f82r/f83r comparison only; no new target corpus, image, reserve, f84/f84r/f116v, decoder, contact, global edit or experiment.

source.edition: Experimentarius medicinae, Trotula chapters IV–VI, Strasbourg/Schott 1544, Bayerische Staatsbibliothek bsb10197839
source.source_status: Complete bounded printed IV–VI account; pre-1420 wording and order are not verified by the owned witness.

quoted_rows.IV15: castoreum, white pepper, costus, mint and apium, one drachm each; grind and mix with white or sweet wine; give two drachms in the evening.
quoted_rows.IV16: dried cumin: one drachm or two spoonfuls as a drink; the alternatives are not silently equated.
quoted_rows.V10: if it has emerged, mix aromatics with absinthium juice and anoint the belly using a feather.
quoted_rows.V11: take equal parts ruta, castoreum and arthemisia; boil in wine until two parts are consumed, then administer as a drink; starting volume is unstated.
quoted_rows.V19: deer heart and laurel leaves, one drachm each, and myrrh, one scruple; grind, mix with wine and give to drink.
quoted_rows.VI05: deer marrow, goose fat, red wax and butter, two ounces each; add foenumgraecum and linseed, cook in water until fully cooked, and introduce by pessary.

IV15: dose_fraction=2/5 of the stated five-D preparation
VI05: foenumgraecum and linseed are unquantified additions
V11: consumed_volume=2u only if the source's two-parts unit u is made explicit
initial volume and final volume are not numerically fixed
IV16: no equality 1D=2H is licensed by the word or

finite_arithmetic_semantics.shared_unknown_numerals: D is a shared unit variable across the explicitly quantified recipes; rho_S, rho_O and rho_H remain positive unknown conversions. No target character, ain/i-count family, decimal base or conventional historical conversion is imported.
finite_arithmetic_semantics.source_observable_consequence: The same semantic inventory must distinguish a total dose after a MIX (IV15), equal initial ingredient shares followed by a CONSUME_VOLUME operation (V11), and an unquantified alternative dose (IV16). Treating all numeric-looking statements as one quantity role loses these written operation differences.

rivals.name: PER_COMPONENT_DOSE
rivals.prediction: IV15's two drachms apply to each of five ingredients, yielding 10D rather than a 2D total dose and dose_fraction 2 instead of 2/5.
rivals.why_distinct: It changes the mixture's total while preserving every printed numeral and ingredient name.

rivals.name: EQUAL_FINAL_PORTIONS
rivals.prediction: V11's equal parts describe final administered portions and ignore the preceding boil/reduction, rather than fixing an initial 1:1:1 ingredient vector followed by volume consumption.
rivals.why_distinct: It predicts equality after processing and cannot preserve a separate consumed-volume event.

rivals.name: FORCED_UNIT_CONVERSION
rivals.prediction: IV16's one drachm and two spoonfuls are treated as equal, and V19's scruple is assigned a fixed drachm fraction without an explicit source conversion.
rivals.why_distinct: It collapses an explicit alternative and adds a unit equation absent from the source.

symmetries_and_degeneracies: Uniform scale D -> lambda*D, S -> lambda*S, O -> lambda*O, H -> lambda*H preserves every dimensionless ratio.
rho_S, rho_O and rho_H are free positive values; the source unit labels do not identify their numerical conversion here.
The five one-D ingredients in IV15 are permutable without changing its arithmetic; ingredient names are source roles, not target identities.
V11's equal-parts vector has free total scale; boiling adds another free initial-volume/consumption pair unless a starting volume is written.
Zero solutions are excluded for explicitly positive dose/unit amounts, but unquantified VI05 additions remain unconstrained rather than set to zero.
A target renaming of preparation, ingredient and unit roles preserves the equations unless an independent written binding breaks it.

target_coverage.already_owned: The existing Trotula dossier records report-owned f82r/f83r whole-page comparison. It found no independently visible dose, weight, ingredient-count, or equal-parts binding; this proposal does not reopen those images.
target_coverage.candidate_scope: If later selected, compare only already recorded complete f82r/f83r configurations for a predeclared repeated ingredient/mixture relation; no f84/f84r/f116v/reserve or new image is authorized.

closest_predecessors.limit: Their provisional drachm/ain/i-count overlays are not reused; no confirmed unit or target quantity meaning is imported.
The parked f2v mass/grade identity branch remains closed; this proposal does not reuse its nine-position assumptions.
Known-role decimal source control has no target binding; this card uses typed dose operations and unit symmetries instead of digit permutation.
Fixed proof-record serializers had no fit; no serializer or Latin conversion code is reopened.

design.strongest_failure: The source gives no explicit drachm-to-scruple/ounce/spoonful conversion, no starting volume for V11, and no independently bound target arithmetic owner. A target fit could therefore absorb the relations through free unit scales or omit unquantified additions. The source arithmetic is useful only as a predeclared typed relation, not as evidence for a target unit or numeral.
design.required_next_binding: Before any target experiment, a report-owned complete target passage must independently expose at least one total-dose versus per-component contrast and one processing relation whose participants and unit scope are fixed without importing ain/i-count values. Otherwise retain this card RAW and do not fit it.
